description: Remove a customer from the merchant's list. Takes the customer ID ONLY — look it up with get_customers and never guess. CONFIRM WITH THE MERCHANT BEFORE CALLING, naming the customer: there is no undo from here. Their past orders are kept. If several customers match, list them and ask which one instead of picking.

customerId.description: Customer id from get_customers — not a name
